purpose: Prove the safe auto-creation policy locally: only low-risk follow_up and meeting_action candidates with all confidence thresholds met are auto-created as proposed Work Items, while candidates failing a confidence threshold or the low-risk class check stay proposed-only with visible policy rationale. Auto-creation is separate from approved external action; every would-be live Dataverse create is receipt-gated and deferred. No tenant writes occur in this slice.

candidates.com_title: Auto-created follow-up: confirm tenant readiness checklist delivery
candidates.com_summary: Low-risk follow-up auto-created from the manual summary source: Doug committed to send the revised tenant readiness checklist to Priya. All policy thresholds were met, so the item is auto-proposed; external action remains separately gated to human approval.
candidates.com_confidence_summary: Source identification 0.95; type 0.90; low-risk classification 0.92; owner 0.88; next-action 0.85. All thresholds met; local sample evidence, not tenant verified.
candidates.com_rationale: The manual summary source explicitly states a follow-up commitment with a named owner and concrete artifact. The source is local summary-allowed evidence; auto-creation proposes the item without external action.
candidates.com_recommended_next_action: Doug approves the auto-proposed follow-up and sends the checklist, or reassigns the commitment. External action requires separate human approval.

policyEvaluation.policy_rationale: All thresholds met: source identification 0.95 >= 0.80, type 0.90 >= 0.80, low-risk classification 0.92 >= 0.80, owner 0.88 >= 0.70, next-action 0.85 >= 0.70. Type follow_up is in the allowed auto-create set and risk class is none (low-risk). Auto-created as proposed; external action remains separately gated to human approval.

candidates.com_summary: Low-risk meeting action auto-created from the manual meeting note source: Doug committed in the platform sync to send the revised tenant readiness checklist to Priya by Friday. candidates.com_confidence_summary: Source identification 0.92; type 0.91; low-risk classification 0.89; owner 0.90; next-action 0.87. All thresholds met; local sample evidence, not tenant verified.
candidates.com_rationale: The meeting summary states an explicit personal commitment with a named recipient, a concrete artifact, and a deadline. The risk class is none and all confidence thresholds are met, so the meeting action is auto-proposed without external action.
candidates.com_recommended_next_action: Doug approves the auto-proposed meeting action and sends the checklist to Priya before Friday, or reassigns the commitment. External action requires separate human approval.

policyEvaluation.policy_rationale: All thresholds met: source identification 0.92 >= 0.80, type 0.91 >= 0.80, low-risk classification 0.89 >= 0.80, owner 0.90 >= 0.70, next-action 0.87 >= 0.70. Type meeting_action is in the allowed auto-create set and risk class is none (low-risk). Auto-created as proposed; external action remains separately gated to human approval.

candidates.com_title: Denied auto-creation: follow-up from unverified Outlook reference
candidates.com_summary: A follow_up candidate derived from the mock Outlook message reference was denied auto-creation because source identification confidence 0.60 is below the policy minimum 0.80. The candidate stays proposed-only until a human reviews the source.
candidates.com_confidence_summary: Source identification 0.60; type 0.85; low-risk classification 0.90; owner 0.75; next-action 0.72. Source identification below threshold; local mock evidence, not tenant verified.
candidates.com_rationale: The Outlook Source Record proves message/conversation reference shape, but live Graph reads are not authorized and the source is mock evidence. Source identification confidence is too low for auto-creation; the candidate stays proposed-only.
candidates.com_recommended_next_action: After live-read approval, compare against a verified Outlook message and decide whether to keep, replace, or ignore the proposed follow-up. A human may manually propose it if desired.
candidates.com_policy_flags: policy_denied; confidence_threshold_not_met; proposal_only; no_external_action; local_contract_evidence_only; no_tenant_write

policyEvaluation.policy_rationale: Source identification confidence 0.60 is below the policy minimum 0.80; the mock Outlook source is not tenant-verified and its body content is not authorized. The candidate stays proposed-only until a human reviews the source and confirms identification.

candidates.com_title: Denied auto-creation: meeting action with delivery risk
candidates.com_summary: A meeting_action candidate derived from the manual meeting note was denied auto-creation because the risk class is delivery, which is not in the low-risk set. The candidate stays proposed-only until a human reviews the delivery risk.
candidates.com_confidence_summary: Source identification 0.90; type 0.88; low-risk classification 0.30; owner 0.82; next-action 0.80. Risk class delivery is not low-risk; local sample evidence, not tenant verified.
candidates.com_rationale: The meeting summary contains a commitment with a deadline, but the risk class is delivery and not none. Auto-creation is restricted to low-risk items, so this candidate stays proposed-only until a human reviews the delivery risk and approves it.
candidates.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the delivery risk, confirms whether auto-creation is appropriate, and either manually approves the proposed item or adjusts the risk classification. External action requires separate human approval.
candidates.com_policy_flags: policy_denied; risk_class_not_low_risk; proposal_only; no_external_action; local_contract_evidence_only; no_tenant_write

policyEvaluation.policy_rationale: Risk class is delivery, which is not in the low-risk set (none). Auto-creation is restricted to low-risk items; this candidate stays proposed-only until a human reviews the delivery risk and approves it.
